title: Changing an address with the IRS
facts: Taxpayers should notify the IRS when their mailing address changes; USPS forwarding alone should not be relied on as the permanent IRS update.
IRS Form 8822 is used by individuals for many home mailing-address changes, while Form 8822-B is used for certain business address or responsible-party changes.
Filing a tax return with the new address can update IRS records, but processing time means separate notification can still matter when correspondence is expected.
Joint filers who establish separate residences should each notify the IRS of their new address.
